title: Supplier's original DEA Form 222 and the monthly copy to DEA
rule_summary: The supplier must retain the original DEA Form 222 that it has filled, in accordance with 21 CFR 1305.17(c). A supplier that is not required to report acquisition and disposition transactions to ARCOS under 21 CFR 1304.33(c), such as a practitioner, must make and submit a copy of the original DEA Form 222 to DEA, either by mail to the Registration Section or by email to the address the regulation gives; the copy must be forwarded at the close of the month during which the order is filled, or, where an order is filled by partial shipments, at the close of the month during which the final shipment is made or the 60-day validity period expires.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can state the paper-route supplier duties, which matter because a pharmacy is the supplier on an order when it returns or distributes Schedule II stock.
common_confusions: The monthly copy to DEA is owed by a supplier that does not report to ARCOS; it is not a duty of the purchasing pharmacy.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1305.13(d) and 21 CFR 1305.17(b) on ecfr.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
